summary: Expand ω(1, g)ϱ_f(x)vac by the finite formula for the Weil action on the vacuum: a sum over the |Δ_f(g)|² cosets of Ô^n ∩ g⁻¹Ô^n in Ô^n of roots of unity times ϱ_f(g(x + y))vac, with the factor Δ_f(g)/|Δ_f(g)|² = C·c/|Δ_f(g)|².

steps.claim: The quotient of Ô^n by the subgroup Ô^n ∩ g⁻¹Ô^n is finite: its index is |Δ_f(g)|² (norm_finMultiplier_sq), which is non-zero because Δ_f(g) ≠ 0.
steps.lean:
have := fintypeOfIndexNeZero
    (mod_cast norm_finMultiplier_sq g ▸ pow_ne_zero 2 (by simp [finMultiplier_ne_zero]))

steps.claim: ω(1, g)ϱ_f(x)vac = (C·c/|Δ_f(g)|²)·∑_y ψ(y)·ϱ_f(g(x + y))vac, the sum over coset representatives y of Ô^n ∩ g⁻¹Ô^n in Ô^n and ψ(y) values of the finite additive character: ω(1, g) commutes ϱ_f(x) to ϱ_f(gx), ω(1, g)vac = Δ_f(g)|Δ_f(g)|⁻²·∑_y ϱ_f(gy)vac (Space.omega_vacElem_sum), products of Heisenberg operators combine up to such characters, and Δ_f(g) = c·C by e.
steps.lean:
simp [V.omega_vacElem_sum, e ▸ mul_div_right_comm .., mul_smul, smul_sum, V.finHeisOp_finHeisOp,
    ← mulVec_add]

steps.claim: So the vector is ∑_y (c/|Δ_f(g)|²)·(C·ψ(y)ϱ_f(g(x + y))vac): a sum over finitely many classes of coefficient c/|Δ_f(g)|², whose d-fold multiple lies in integralAway(q) by hc, and whose total size at σ is (number of classes)·|σ(c)|/|Δ_f(g)|² = |σ(c)| ≤ 1 under p by hp (of_sum). Each vector C·ψ(y)ϱ_f(g(x + y))vac is a root of unity ψ(y) times C·ϱ_f(z)vac with z = g(x + y) ∈ A by I, so of_eq_isOfFinOrder_smul turns the combination into one of the C·ϱ_f(z)vac, z ∈ A.
steps.lean:
refine .of_eq_isOfFinOrder_smul (.of_sum ?_ ?_) fun y _ ↦ ⟨_, isOfFinOrder_ψf _, _, I _ y.out.2,
    smul_comm ..⟩ <;> simp_all [relIndex, index, ← ofReal_pow, norm_finMultiplier_sq, field]
